items.description: Awesome online tutorials to help you write your first analyzers, code fixes, and source generators.

items.title: How To Write a C# Analyzer and Code Fix
items.description: The mother of all Roslyn tutorials :-) A realistic step-by-step introduction to syntax and semantic analysis as well as the syntax transformation.

items.title: C# Source Generators
items.description: Comprehensive list of additional learning sources, samples, and experimental and productive source generators. A perfect reference once you grasp the basics.

items.title: Tutorials

items.description: Awesome open source projects built on top of Roslyn.

items.title: dotnet-script
items.description: Runs C# scripts from the .NET CLI, defines NuGet packages inline and edit/debugs them in VS Code.

items.title: RoslynQuoter
items.description: Online tool that for a given C# program generates syntax tree API calls that construct syntax tree of that program.

items.title: FlubuCore
items.description: Cross platform build automation tool for building projects and executing deployment scripts using C# code.

items.title: Code Converter
items.description: C# to VB.NET and VB.NET to C# transpiler.

items.title: roslyn-linq-rewrite
items.description: Compiles C# code by first rewriting the syntax trees of LINQ expressions using plain procedural code. This increases performance by minimizes heap allocations and dynamic dispatch.

items.title: Scripty
items.description: Tool to use Roslyn-powered C# scripts for code generation. You can think of it as a scripted alternative to T4 templates.

items.title: CodeGeneration.Roslyn
items.description: Roslyn-based Code Generation during a build with design-time support.

items.title: Testura.Code
items.description: Wrapper around the Roslyn API used for generation, saving, and compiling C# code. Provides methods and helpers to generate classes, methods, statements, and expressions.

items.title: MirrorSharp
items.description: Online C#, VB.NET, and F# code editor. Features code completion, method signature help, quick fixes, and diagnostics.

items.title: Uno SourceGenerator
items.description: C# source code generator based on a project being built, using all of its syntactic and semantic model information.

items.title: CodeAnalysis.CSharp.PatternMatching
items.description: Intuitive pattern matching for Roslyn syntax trees. Simplifies C# syntax and semantic analysis.

items.title: Open Source Projects

items.description: Awesome open source analyzers, code fixes, and refactorings.

items.title: Roslynator
items.description: Collection of 190+ analyzers and 190+ refactorings for C#. Covers coding style, code readability and simplification, removing redundancies, fixing compiler errors, and many more.

items.title: StyleCop Analyzers for the .NET Compiler Platform
items.description: Port of StyleCop rules to Roslyn.

items.title: .NET Compiler Platform ("Roslyn") Analyzers
items.description: Diagnostic analyzers developed by the Roslyn team. Initially developed to help flesh out the design and implementation of the static analysis APIs. The analyzers cover code quality, .NET Core, desktop .NET Framework, comments in code, and more.

items.title: Code Cracker
items.description: Analyzer library for C# and VB.NET. Offers diagnostics in many categories like performance, coding styles, as well as some basic refactorings.

items.title: ErrorProne.NET
items.description: Set of analyzers and code fixes focusing on the correctness and performance of C# programs. Inspired with Google's Error Prone.

items.title: Mapping Generator
items.description: Code fix that generates arbitrary complex object-object mappings. It recognizes out of the box a large number of scenarios where mappings are used. A design-time alternative to AutoMapper.

items.title: SonarC#
items.description: Static code analyzer for C# language used as an extension for the SonarQube platform.

items.title: Roslyn Clr Heap Allocation Analyzer
items.description: C# heap allocation analyzer that can detect explicit and many implicit allocations like boxing, closures, implicit delegate creations, etc.

items.title: Refactoring Essentials for Visual Studio
items.description: Refactorings, analyzers and code fixes for C# and VB.NET.

items.title: CSharpGuidelinesAnalyzer
items.description: Reports diagnostics for C# coding guidelines (https://csharpcodingguidelines.com/).

items.title: VSDiagnostics
items.description: Collection of code-quality analyzers. Covers usages of async methods, flags enums, best practices in exception handling as well as many other code-quality checks.

items.title: Nullable.Extended
items.description: Roslyn tools and analyzers to improve the experience when coding with nullable reference types.

items.title: Open Source Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

items.description: Awesome libraries and frameworks for testing analyzers, code fixes, and refactorings.

items.title: Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing
items.description: Library for testing analyzers and code fixes with NUnit, xUnit and MSTest frameworks. A part of Roslyn SDK.

items.title: RoslynTestKit
items.description: Lightweight framework for writing unit tests for analyzers, code fixes, refactorings, and completion providers. It's unit testing framework agnostic.

items.title: Libraries and Frameworks for Testing Analyzers, Code Fixes, and Refactorings

items.description: Awesome (but mostly experimental at the moment, because .NET 5.0 and C# 9.0 are still in preview) source generators and open source projects that internally use source generators.

items.title: StrongInject
items.description: Compile-time dependency injection container. Compile-time checked, reflection-free and runtime code generation free, thus fast and app-trimming-friendly.

items.title: Generator.Equals
items.description: Automatically implements equality and hashing for classes and records. Supports different comparison strategies. Offers similar functionality like IL weaving-based Equals.Fody.

items.title: JsonSrcGen
items.description: Reflection-free JSON serializer. Allows extremely fast JSON processing by generating reflection-free serializers at the compile time.

items.title: StructPacker
items.description: Low-level, lightweight and performance-focused serializer for C# struct types. Auto-generates C# serialization code to achieve peak runtime performance and efficiency.

items.title: WrapperValueObject
items.description: Creates boilerplate free wrappers around types. Especially useful for creating strongly typed wrappers around primitive types.

items.title: DpDtInject
items.description: Proof-of-concept of a dependency injection container that transfers huge piece of resolving logic to the compilation stage. Offers additional compile-time safety and fast runtime resolution.

items.title: Svg to C# Source Generators
items.description: SVG to C# compiler. Compiles SVG drawing markup to C# using SkiaSharp as rendering engine.

items.title: Source Generators
